title: Counting values in an indexed prefix
statement: Let $n$ and $i$ be natural numbers, let $f$ assign an element of a type to each index $j<n$, and let $a$ be an element of that type. The number of occurrences of $a$ among the first $i$ entries of the list of values of $f$ equals the number of indices $j<n$ such that $j<i$ and $f(j)=a$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $f$ from indices $j<n$ to a type
